question: Should Skill Workshop add exact core previews and make approval-generated lifecycle calls snapshot-bound by default?
rationale: The patch is technically correct and well proven, but it introduces a new core workflow and intentionally changes what happens when a proposal is revised during a pending approval.

options.title: Accept core preview and binding
options.body: Merge the portable review action and reject decisions against proposals revised after the approval prompt was created.

options.title: Preview without automatic binding
options.body: Keep exact previews but preserve current pending-approval semantics unless callers explicitly pass a reviewed version.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep current approval behavior and revisit proposal previews under a separately sponsored workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept core preview and binding
recommendation.body: Merge the portable review action and reject decisions against proposals revised after the approval prompt was created.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced Skill Workshop and is the current assignee, making them the best available owner for the product decision.
